Hi Javier —

Thanks for flagging this and for the attached notice. We take these requests seriously. A few quick notes and questions to make sure we meet Acme's needs without breaking our standard retention and compliance controls: 

- Short answer: we can create a targeted preservation hold for AcmeCorp backups and logs while the legal hold is in effect, but we need to scope the exact objects (which buckets, which snapshot ranges, which log indices).
- Our default backup purge schedule is 30 days for incremental snapshots and 365 days for full archived snapshots. We also have a separate log retention default of 90 days for high-volume request logs; audit and security logs are retained for 1 year.
- For preservation we can: (a) mark snapshot objects as "legal_hold" in S3 (customer tag) to exclude them from automated purge, and (b) take an immutable archive copy to our long-term archive tier. This requires an infra runbook change and a short ticket to infra to suspend the scheduled purge for those objects.

Could you confirm: do you need preservation of all data since 2024-12-01, or a narrower window? Also, do you want us to produce the preserved copies and provide checksums, or to leave them in-situ with legal-hold metadata?

I'll loop in Rishi (sales) and Neha (security/compliance) to coordinate.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Enterprise Sales (Redwood Inference)

Hi all —

Quick answers from the security/compliance side: 

- We can accept the PDF notice for an initial hold, but per our policy we require (1) a signed legal hold or court order for holds longer than 30 days, or (2) a case tracking id from the requesting legal department plus a named point of contact who can authorize retention beyond 30 days. If Acme can provide a signed confirmation this week we will mark the hold as authorized for 180 days, pending extension.
- DPA impact: Section 7 covers backups and cross-border transfer. If we copy preserved backups to our long-term archive in a different region, that is a data transfer. We need a Data Transfer Impact Assessment signed off by DPO if transfers cross jurisdictions. For now, we will preserve in-situ in the same region unless Acme authorizes cross-region archival.
- Subprocessors: our infra vendor (CloudStor Inc.) currently holds backup objects; per DPA Appendix B they are a subprocessor. We will inform them of the legal hold and require them to suspend any automated purge for the scoped objects.

I'll request a preservation ticket with infra and prepare a short DPO checklist.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

3) Timeline & cost: infra estimates 48 hours to tag and verify (ticket INF-4821). There will be a one-time operational charge to create archive copies if requested (estimate attached in backup_index_snapshot_20250713.csv).
4) Documentation: we will provide checksums and a preservation report once completed. For holds >30 days we will need signed confirmation from Acme's legal team to extend retention.

Please reply with: (A) confirmation that the scope above is correct; and (B) whether Acme authorizes cross-region archival. Once we get (A) we will open the infra ticket and begin preservation.
